= Render parity review: Sirena vs the PlantUML JAR
:toc:

Refs claricle/metanorma-plugin-sirena#1, acceptance 2 (render parity reviewed
against the PlantUML JAR for the corpus; semantic/visual, not byte parity).

== Method (measured 2026-11-04)

* Reference: PlantUML 1.2026.9 (`plantuml.jar -tsvg -p`, include path set to
  `spec/fixtures/corpus` and `includes/`). All 73 fixtures render in the JAR
  without a syntax error.
* Sirena: commit `fca111132` (sirena PR #353, `feat/plantuml-class-state`,
  which contains activity/usecase/component from main `9b1e64ae8`), plugin
  corpus from PR #4 (`feat/corpus-coverage`), includes expanded by the plugin's
  `PlantumlPreprocessor`, `Sirena.render(source)` with notation auto-detect.
  (Forcing `notation: :plantuml` breaks `@startsalt`; do not.)
* Both SVGs rasterised with `rsvg-convert` and compared side by side (JAR
  left, Sirena right), plus a text-token diff of the `<text>` content.
  Rasters are not committed.
* Not covered by this run: sirena PR #352 (activity `kill`, fixture 6-5).

== Counts

73 fixtures: 39 render through Sirena (main alone: 33). Of the 39:
16 match (same elements and labels, only styling/geometry differ),
19 partial, 4 gap. 34 do not render (listing fallback).
With PR #352, 6-5 renders (not measured here).

== Rendered fixtures

Styling that differs everywhere and is not repeated per row: Sirena uses
heavier strokes, white participant boxes with black borders, monospace class
members, `<<stereotype>>` text instead of the C/I/E/A badges, `+`/`-`
visibility characters instead of icons, 1.2-2x larger canvases.

== Regression to note

* 9-15 (`[*] --> Active` with `note left of`): Sirena main renders it as a
  *component* diagram (wrong: `*` is a component, states are circles). Under
  PR #353 the same source is routed to the state family and fails with
  "state statement note is not yet supported", so the block falls back to a
  listing. The JAR draws a state diagram with two notes.

== Not rendered (34): reason

* Other PlantUML families, "not yet supported" or undetected: json 11-1/2/3, 2-18; yaml
  12-3-1/2, 12-6; nwdiag 13-1-2, 13-4-1; timing 10-1-2, 10-16, 10-7-2; gantt
  16-1-1; mindmap 17-2/3/4/6-3; wbs 18-1, 18-7; ebnf custom-filename.
* Object/map diagrams 4-2, 4-6-3, 4-6-5, 4-8; `@startuml PERT` 4-7; entity 20-3
  (`skinparam linetype`).
* Needs bundled library/assets: 27-3 (`awslib`), 15-2 (archimate sprites), 5-7 (`<img>`).
* `<style>` blocks: 6-25-2.
* Activity `kill` 6-5 (PR #352); state note 9-15 (above).
* By design: 1-12-invalid (missing `@enduml`), `sequences` (library of two diagrams).

== Top gaps to fix (by severity)

. State composite layout (9-3-1, 9-5): unreadable output; plus 9-15 regression.
. Class box height with members (3-6, layout-option): content clipped by the box and canvas.
. Edge-label collisions on fan-out edges (6-10-4, 6-4, 8-4-4).
. Creole / `<math>` inline markup not applied (1-19, 19-0-1, 6-3).
. Bracketed edge styles on class diagrams (3-35-4) and component containers
  shapes (7-5).
